mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_review_comment (review_id, user_id, content, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS username, u.avatar AS avatar FROM stellar_review_comment c LEFT JOIN stellar_mall_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.review_id = #{reviewId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_review_comment WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 1
